summary: All four r1 findings resolved per the recorded rulings and committed (61028d6): F1 gives the A.5 throwaway deploy repo its own phase P5a (Target ../ProofDeploy), built to the hook's actual clone contract with its own gate, replacing the ordering bullet that assigned it to the test phase; F2 adds enable-ssl: "yes" alongside is-public: "no" everywhere argocd-server's exposure appears and makes V10 check a real 443 listener with a step-ca leaf; F3 rewires the repo-server's homelab-CA trust through the upstream subchart's own values surfaces with the trust reaching the container as the phase's success condition; F4 rewords the bootstrap bullet to name P6. Also: P4 gains the cross-namespace RBAC constraint P5a's Terraform is the first consumer of, verification.json gains V30 and extends V27/V28, close-out gains S3 and S4. One operator input is owed before the run starts: --dry-run cannot resolve ../ProofDeploy until the operator creates the disposable repo with an initial commit, adds it to /work/Ansible/.kubecoder/config.yaml and runs kc env sync — exactly what the F1 ruling calls for, and recorded in the ordering constraints.
